CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 7
   C. 19
   D. 17

3. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 25

4. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 7

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

8. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

12. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. D — 17
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 8² + 15²
3. c² = 64 + 225
4. c² = 289
5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
